en: All damage +4%. Execute: instantly kills normal enemies when their HP is below 15%, and Elite enemies below 8% (Bosses excepted)
_zh: 全体伤害 +4%。处决：普通敌人生命低于 15%、精英低于 8% 时直接击杀（Boss 除外）

en: Leader Max HP +4%. Once per run: when taking fatal damage, survives with 1 HP and takes no damage for 1.5s
_zh: 队长最大生命 +4%。每次探索限一次：受到致命伤时保留 1 点生命，1.5 秒内不受伤害

en: Damage taken by Leader -2%. After taking no damage for 5s, the next damage taken -50%
_zh: 队长受到伤害 -2%。连续 5 秒未受伤后，下一次 -50%

en: Leader recovers +0.2 HP per second. Recovery doubles when HP is below 35%
_zh: 队长每秒回复 +0.2 生命。生命低于 35% 时回复翻倍

en: Leader Objective Shield limit +1 (generates 1 stack every 15s). When Objective Shield breaks, reflects: enemies within a 140 radius take Physical damage equal to 300% of Leader ATK and suffer knockback (Bosses immune to knockback)
_zh: 队长护盾上限 +1（每 15 秒生成一层）。护盾破碎时反震：周围 140 范围敌人受队长攻击 ×3 物理伤害并击退（Boss 免疫击退）

en: EXP +7%. Leveling up has a 10% chance to grant an additional level
_zh: 经验 +7%。升级有 10% 概率再升一级

en: First level up grants 1 additional option (choose 1 of 4)
_zh: 第一次升级多一个选项（四选一）

en: Once per run: Refreshing the Merchant's wares costs 0 Originium Ingots
_zh: 每次探索限一次：刷新行商货架时不消耗源石锭

en: At the start of a run, choose 1 of 3 basic Collectibles
_zh: 开局从 3 件基础藏品中选 1 件
队长每秒回复 +0.2 生命
队长每秒回复 +0.2 生命

en: Once per run: when Leader falls, revives with 50% Max HP and takes no damage for 3s
_zh: 每次探索限一次：队长倒下时以 50% 最大生命复活，3 秒内不受伤害

en: Physical damage taken by Leader -8% (multiplicative; ineffective against Arts and True damage)
_zh: 队长受到的物理伤害 -8%（乘算；对法术、真实伤害无效）

en: Light lost when Leader is attacked -15%
Dash can store 2 charges; cooldown recovers sequentially
_zh: 冲刺可储存 2 次，冷却逐次恢复

en: Ranged normal attacks pierce 2 additional enemies.
_zh: 远程普攻可再穿透 2 名敌人。

en: When normal attacks from Melee Extended Range, Summon, and Crowd-Control Detonation Operators hit, other enemies within a 60 radius of the target take 25% of the damage.
_zh: 近战扩域、召唤驻场、控场引爆干员的普攻命中时，目标周围 60 范围内的其他敌人受到该次伤害的 25%。

en: Normal attacks from Multi-target Firepower Operators bounce to 1 other enemy within a 170 radius upon hit, dealing 50% of the damage.
_zh: 多弹火力干员的普攻命中后弹向 170 范围内的另 1 名敌人，造成该次伤害的 50%。

en: Melee Extended Range Operators attack range +12%
_zh: 近战扩域干员攻击范围 +12%
多弹火力干员攻击速度 +10%

en: Stationary Summon Operators' follow-up and summon damage +10%
_zh: 召唤驻场干员的追击与召唤物伤害 +10%
眩晕、束缚、减速的持续时间 +15%

en: Weakness Harvesting Operators deal +10% additional Weakness damage
_zh: 弱点收割干员的弱点伤害额外 +10%
队长立刻回复 30% 最大生命

en: Obtain the other 8 medals in the 'Beneath the Deep Blue' medal set.
_zh: 获得「深蓝之下」套组中的其余 8 枚蚀刻章。
达成结局「平凡即是喜乐」。

_zh: 达成结局「如星空般深蓝」。

_zh: 在一次探索中，使编队内 3 名干员同时达到精英二。
